patterns.message: The identity-scoped Prisma client is restricted to src/lib/identity/*. Import from '@/lib/identity' (the narrow public API) instead.
The platform-scoped Prisma client is restricted to src/lib/platform/*. Import from '@/lib/platform' (the narrow public API) instead.

no-restricted-syntax.message: identity.identityRecord (PII) may only be queried from src/lib/identity/*.
platform.platformStaffAccount may only be queried from src/lib/platform/*.
platform.breakGlassUnlock may only be queried from src/lib/platform/*.
